meta_description:
learnchemistrywithmisskays on February 21, 2025: "I’ve been a teacher / tutor for 15 years and I’m not ashamed to admit 

1) I still prepare for my class every single day. I make sure to spend some time before my class preparing for it 

2) I still don’t like Thermodynamics and this means I work extra hard to make sure that my students don’t have a mental block with it like I do

3) I am afraid of JEE problems and that’s why I don’t take classes for JEE because I don’t think I can solve them 

4) I tend to get emotionally invested in my students progress and I have a tough time dealing with it when they don’t do as well as I hope they would.

5) I did not like Chemistry when I was in class 11 and I blame that on the teacher I had. This trauma is what drives me. I wake up every day thinking - how can I make this subject better for my students. 

6) I truly believe that accepting my weaknesses and owning them makes me a better person. This honesty is why many parents and students trust that I can help them in their journey. 

#learnchemistrywithmisskays #studygramindia #onlinechemistrytutor #experiencespeaks #imnotashamed".
